cost_basis: Estimated at OpenAI's public API prices, checked 2026-10-02, from the run's token totals in agent-log.txt (added after the run). Standard rates apply: the log has no per-request counts, but only 83,546 input tokens in the whole run were uncached, and each request mostly re-reads the one before it from cache, so none came near the 272K-token long-context threshold.
